question: Whether bounded mechanical seam color matching is permitted and which existing local utilities can inform it.
policyConclusion: Permitted for already drawn, structurally continuous seams under the explicit project/user instructions. Geometry defects or missing structure still require redraw. The current review did not authorize or apply pixel changes.

rules.quote: 几何错位应重绘修正；羽化只用于细小纹理过渡，不能用模糊掩盖错位。
rules.application: Exclude west round-stone/squared-stone mismatch and any subsequently confirmed geometry break from tone-only correction.

rules.quote: 对已重绘完成的接缝，可在保留原生尺寸的前提下做有限的亚像素配准和局部色彩匹配。须记录位移上限、实际位移、重采样、遮罩及校正场，并复查原像素效果。
rules.application: RGB-only addition with zero displacement and no raster resampling is within the allowed local color matching scope. Store exact field, mask, bounds, hashes and native-pixel QA.

rules.quote: 裁切、缩放、拼接、去背景等未再次调用生成模型的派生图，记录 derivedFrom 及 operation，由此追溯原始模型与质量；多来源拼接逐一列出来源，不把后处理记成新模型生成。
rules.application: Record tone correction as a mechanical derivative; retain source model/quality uncertainty and source SHA chains.

utilities.suitability: Most directly reusable algorithm for current color-only internal seams.
utilities.algorithm: Samples RGB jump at seam while excluding high-variation rows; interpolates valid samples along seam, smooths correction field only, clips estimated jump to +/-24, splits it between two sides for <=12 per-channel per-pass addition, uses smoothstep falloff within 192 pixels of seam and optional longitudinal segments. No raster blur, geometric movement or resampling.
adaptationRequired: Hardcoded to another appearance r08_c09, 4326 extended canvas and +115 offset. Must not import or run unchanged: top-level code creates outputs and applies all listed seams.
Current r08_c11 source is 4096 core, so coordinate system and mask support need explicit conversion.
Low-gradient validity threshold |jump|<30 may exclude strongest observed red-channel roof discontinuities; do not silently increase bounds or interpolate across different materials.
Validate per-material masks and co-located 230-pixel native overlaps; correction field interpolation can itself make a stripe. Track cumulative, not only per-pass, change.

utilities.suitability: Useful exact replay and locally attenuated-field repair pattern.
utilities.algorithm: Reconstructs an already corrected band from original pixels plus saved RGB field; attenuates a visually confirmed spurious stripe with a bounded smooth mask. Asserts exact preservation outside support and stores replacement field, adjustment field and masks.
adaptationRequired: Its observed tone-v2 stripe proves the first utility is not automatically safe or visually accepted.
Hardcoded source hashes/rectangles are specific to another task. Reuse the replay/unchanged-outside-mask checks, not its coordinates or source files.

utilities.suitability: Useful bounded parameter/field reporting, not needed for current purely tonal vertical findings.
utilities.algorithm: Estimates regularized vertical subpixel displacement (<=10 pixels), uses bicubic remap, then smooths median overlap RGB residual and clips tone to <=12. Stores mask and flow/correction archive.
adaptationRequired: Do not apply geometry warp to an already connected seam merely to correct color.
Any future registration needs separate observed geometry evidence and explicit resampling record.

utilities.suitability: Useful narrow ROI, bounded additive tone and exact outside-mask preservation checks after actual structural redraw.
utilities.algorithm: Uses existing registered repair field, a 12-pixel vector bound, local tone clamp and binary crop mask; leaves old neighbor and pixels outside a 100x404 new-tile corridor exact.
adaptationRequired: This is a structural-repair follow-up with optical flow and inherited tone. It is not a drop-in color-only process.
Runs imported source text from another file at top level; inspect/adapt into own scope rather than execute unchanged.

utilities.suitability: Existing same-appearance assembly pattern, not a bounded tonal matcher.
utilities.algorithm: Chooses minimum-error seam in 230-pixel overlaps, then alpha-blends using a radius-2 mask; source raster dimensions are preserved.
adaptationRequired: Hardcoded E:/ path and old record schema.
Does not produce an explicit bounded additive color field; blending cannot be used to hide the western stone geometry mismatch.

recommendedScopedApproach: Start from verified r08_c11 source and correction masks that cover only reviewed color discontinuities. Keep geometry unchanged (shift 0, resampling none).
Estimate low-frequency color residual from corresponding native overlap pixels only where structural alignment is visually confirmed, segmenting by material/shadow when needed.

Use conservative bounded additive RGB fields; record chosen per-pass and cumulative channel limits, actual maximum, clipping counts and changed-pixel bounding boxes. Smooth the field rather than the source raster.
Save source SHA, reproducible script/parameters, float field, exact mask and derived output sidecar. Assert bit-identical pixels outside mask.
Review all affected full seams, mask boundaries and crossings at native pixels; do not treat numerical seam-error reduction as visual acceptance.
If tone field cannot resolve a seam without damaging highlights or material, use the already documented native AI repair window with exact geometry context.
